facts.fact: Kitsilano Beach is at Cornwall Avenue and the north end of Yew Street; the Seawall runs alongside it and Kitsilano Pool is to the west.
The city lists washrooms, playground, sports courts and seasonal lifeguards. The pool is an outdoor salt-water facility with separate information.
